title: Item Synergies
subtitle: Soul Knight Prequel 1.13.0 — which legendary effects feed each other
byline: Built from the game's own effect text for the 201 items whose legendary effect is known. Hover or tap an underlined keyword to see its in-game rules.
reading_note: Each combo is a set of items that fit in **different slots**, so you can wear them together, unless a note says it competes for a slot. A combo usually has one item that builds a stack or state and one or more that pay off on it. The notes say which is which.
tldr: Every element has an engine: one item builds its keyword stacks, another cashes them in. Fire covers five slots on its own.
Murmuring Ring turns any ailment into $yishang$. Pair it with Censurer's Necklace and any ailment source.
Low-life builds: Exothermal Necklace makes you permanently $binwei$, which turns on half a dozen armor, helm and ring effects.
Traumatic Spiral + Noxia Sinistrorum: the ring's crit-damage penalty stops mattering.
The numbers are hidden in encrypted config. This page shows what works together, not how much.

blocks.text: Each element has a keyword that stacks on you or on the enemy. One item generates the stacks; the others spend them or scale off them.

blocks.text:
**Harrier's Headguard** (no shields) turns off every shield item: Mana Pump, Guardsman Badge, Sangrilok Helm, Starforged Battlegarb.
**Welkin-Jade Thimble** drains mana, while **Cirque of Omniscience** and **Celesturgy Locket** want it high.
**Exothermal Necklace** keeps you $binwei$, which switches off **Plumesilk Vestments** and **Vitality Ring** (they need $jiankang$).
**Grimhowl Choker** and **Noxia Sinistrorum** cut crit damage, so keep them out of crit-damage builds.
**Ensorcelled Wardrobe** lowers resistances, which works against **The Lacuna** and **Dauntless Wartreads**.
**Knight's Relic** pieces (1 enemy near) and **Crown of the Martial Saint** (many enemies near) pull opposite ways.

limits: Every combo comes from the item effect text in the 1.13.0 APK. Only 201 of 806 equipment pieces have a known legendary effect, so more combos exist. Numbers in gold were read off in-game codex screenshots; `?` values live in encrypted config, so this page shows which effects work together, not how strong they are. Nothing here was tested in game.
